At temperature T1, particles of substance X are close together and slide over each other.
At temperature T2, substance X is made up of particles that are close together and vibrate in
fixed positions.
What is the name of the change of state substance X undergoes when its temperature changes
from T1 to T2?
A
melting
B
boiling
C
freezing
D
condensing
subject: Chemistry
